name: Gandhamrit Ras

sections.introduction: Gandhamrit ras is a classical formulation. This Ayurvedic remedy is used as a Vajikaran that means as an Aphrodisiac.
sections.ingredients:
Ras-Sindoor (Mercury formation) – 1 part 
 Shuddha Gandhak (Purified Sulphur) – 2 parts
sections.description_of_ingredients:
Ras-Sindoor – This is a preparation of mercury. It is widely used as an ingredient in mostly Ayurvedic medicines. This is used as an aphrodisiac. Ras-Sindoor is a herbal and mineral composition. This is also used to improve immunity and strength of the body. 
 Shuddha Gandhak – Sulphur is used as a medicinal purpose in many diseases. It is used after purification which is called Shodhan kriya in Ayurveda. Gandhak is widely used in the treatment of digestive problems, reproductive system etc. It is also used in various types of skin diseases. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Properly mixes Ras-Sindoor in a kharal yantra. 
 After mixing add Gandhak and again properly mixes it together. 
 Cooked this formulation under laghuput. 
 After this process make 250 mg tablets and let them dry under the shadow. 
 Keep these tablets in a glass container. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Gandhamrit ras is an Ayurvedic formulation. This Ayurvedic remedy is used in the treatment of sexual problems. This formulation is also used in erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation, infertility etc. The ingredient Gandhak is used in skin disorders and helps in pacifying pitta dosha.

Gandhamrit Ras 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Vajikaranadhikar 1132/78 
 Introduction 
 Gandhamrit ras is a classical formulation. This Ayurvedic remedy is used as a Vajikaran that means as an Aphrodisiac. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ras-Sindoor (Mercury formation) – 1 part 
 Shuddha Gandhak (Purified Sulphur) – 2 parts 
 
 Description of Ingredients 
 
 Ras-Sindoor – This is a preparation of mercury. It is widely used as an ingredient in mostly Ayurvedic medicines. This is used as an aphrodisiac. Ras-Sindoor is a herbal and mineral composition. This is also used to improve immunity and strength of the body. 
 Shuddha Gandhak – Sulphur is used as a medicinal purpose in many diseases. It is used after purification which is called Shodhan kriya in Ayurveda. Gandhak is widely used in the treatment of digestive problems, reproductive system etc. It is also used in various types of skin diseases. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Properly mixes Ras-Sindoor in a kharal yantra. 
 After mixing add Gandhak and again properly mixes it together. 
 Cooked this formulation under laghuput. 
 After this process make 250 mg tablets and let them dry under the shadow. 
 Keep these tablets in a glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Gandhamrit ras is an Ayurvedic formulation. This Ayurvedic remedy is used in the treatment of sexual problems. This formulation is also used in erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation, infertility etc. The ingredient Gandhak is used in skin disorders and helps in pacifying pitta dosha. 
 Indications 
 
 Infertility 
 Loss of libido 
 Erectile dysfunction 
 Premature ejaculation 
 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet twice a day with honey of ghee. 
 Cautions 
 Avoid taking without any medical advice. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
